title: Garam Masala Comedy Dating Show: Cuffing Season Coming to SF
description: America's #1 Comedy Desi Dating Show is NOW IN SF! Watch a couple go on a real blind date in front of a LIVE audience. Feeling adventurous?
long_description:
America's #1 Comedy Desi Dating Show is NOW IN SF! Watch a couple go on a real blind date in front of a LIVE audience. Feeling adventurous?

About this Event

Two strangers. One stage. A packed room full of people who came to watch it all go down.
Garam Masala Dating is the biggest live comedy dating show in the country. Every show, a real couple goes on a blind date in front of a live audience while hosts Surbhi and Wyatt Feegrado play wingman, roast them and try to keep things from going completely off the rails.
And if you're in the audience and single and like what you see, you can actually steal one of the daters for yourself. Right there. On stage. In front of everyone.
More details - www.garammasaladating.com/apply After the show, the night continues with an afterparty so the shy folks can try to shoot their shot with our amazing contestants as well!
What to expect:
A full live blind date with all the awkward, hilarious, romantic moments you'd normally only hear about secondhandThe chance to jump on stage and steal a single for yourselfAn afterparty where the audience can meet each other and exchange numbers90 to 120 minutes of comedy, chaos and genuine connectionA packed room who are all there because they love a good timeYou don't need to be single. You don't need to be South Asian. You just need to show up ready to laugh.
4 seasons. 50+ shows. 50 million views on our clips. Over 200,000 followers across platforms. This is the show everyone keeps telling you about.
Doors open at 4:30 pm. The show starts at 5:00 pm sharp.
There is very limited parking on the street so please account for that in your travel time.
Directions: At The Faight Collective, 473A Haight St, San Francisco, CA 94117
Join us for an unforgettable night and see why Garam Masala is the hottest dating show in the country!

Additional Information:
Tickets are non-refundable.
By attending this event, you agree to be recorded and consent to the use of the resulting content for promotional purp
